text: Highmark Health is the parent company of Highmark Inc., Allegheny Health Network and HM Health Solutions, and describes itself as the third-largest integrated health care delivery and financing system in the nation.

source.quote: Highmark Health is the parent company of Highmark Inc., Allegheny Health Network and HM Health Solutions.
source.text: Highmark Health is a private, nonprofit integrated health delivery and financing system, parent of Highmark Inc. and Allegheny Health Network, with no state ownership.
source.short: Highmark Health is a private, nonprofit integrated health delivery and financing system, parent of Highmark Inc.
